messages:
elles: Heads-up - customers hitting duplicate side-effects from the onboarding sample app when a token refresh and a 429 happen at the same time. Two reports this week.
raj: Can you share a minimal log snippet? sounds like immediate replay after refresh.
jin: Most likely cause: SDK refresh completes, client replays original request immediately with no jitter and no idempotency header. Server accepted both.
elles: snippet (sanitized):
2026-03-20T09:21:03Z INFO auth: refreshing token
2026-03-20T09:21:03Z WARN api: 429 rate_limit route=/v1/createOrder
2026-03-20T09:21:03Z INFO auth: refresh complete
2026-03-20T09:21:03Z INFO client: replaying request immediately
2026-03-20T09:21:03Z INFO api: request processed id=ord_abc123
2026-03-20T09:21:03Z INFO api: request processed id=ord_abc124
elles: both creates within ~40ms. :grimacing:
raj: Quick fixes: 1) sample app should set an Idempotency-Key for create operations, 2) SDK should apply a tiny randomized delay when replaying after a refresh (e.g. 10-200ms), 3) emit telemetry flag when a replay follows auth refresh so we can detect cases.
jin: Agree. For the SDK I'd prefer configurable behavior: `replayProtection: 'off'|'lenient'|'strict'` where lenient = jitter+telemetry, strict = refuse to replay non-idempotent writes without Idempotency-Key. Default stays lenient for compatibility.
elles: For onboarding docs: add a short "Avoid duplicate side-effects" section showing Idempotency-Key example and explaining why jitter matters.
raj: Also adding server-side best-effort dedupe would help (short window, e.g. 250ms). But that is infra work and not always feasible for all endpoints.
elles: CI/QA: jin can you add a regression test that simulates 429+refresh and ensures only one create?
jin: yep - will add test harness that flaps 429 every N calls and forces refresh; assert single resource created. will add to sampleapp test suite.
ci-bot: Created issue: devex/dup-sideeffect-360210 (steps + expected results).
raj: One more UX note: update SDK logs when replaying after refresh to include `replay_suspect=true` in structured logs so ops can triage.
elles: Plan: 1) sampleapp PR (Idempotency-Key example + test) 2) SDK PR (replayProtection config + jitter + telemetry) 3) docs update 4) infra dedupe investigation.
jin: I'll open the sampleapp PR first and link the CI test.
elles: thanks all. tagging @raj for SDK PR. any objections? :thumbsup:
raj: :thumbsup:
jin: :thumbsup:
